messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Fluoxetine is FDA-approved to treat the following conditions:
Major depressive disorder (MDD) for acute and maintenance treatment in adults and children aged 8 years and older
Obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) for acute and maintenance treatment in adults and children aged 7 years and older
Bulimia nervosa for acute and maintenance treatment of binge-eating and purging in adults with moderate to severe bulimia
Panic disorder for the treatment of panic attacks in adults
When used in combination with olanzapine, fluoxetine is also FDA-approved for:
Acute treatment of depressive episodes associated with Bipolar I disorder (depressive episodes) in adults and children aged 10 years and older
Treatment-resistant depression for adults who have not responded to at least two adequate antidepressant trials
Fluoxetine alone is not approved for bipolar I depressive episodes or treatment-resistant depression.
Olanzapine must be used in combination for these indications.
Triplet: ["Fluoxetine", "fda approved to treat", "Bulimia nervosa"]

The relation 'fda approved to treat' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is officially approved by the FDA to treat the medical condition specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'is approved for': The subject drug has received FDA approval for the medical condition or indication specified by the object entity.
B. 'fda approval year': The subject drug was approved by the US FDA in the year specified by the object entity.
C. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'has benefit': The subject drug provides the health benefit specified by the object entity.
E. 'has related treatment guide': The subject drug is associated with the medical treatment guide specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
